== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rogue 1 (Japanese)|Rogue 1]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/141198259/z3_pcQsYrE-E016g3EG6-Q.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 74248139.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>8efc860cbc0051dc7173cf7a48fa97620682278c1ca8d40a390611b6c6f8f108</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
